name: Interagency Coordination and Construction Permits Data (MOSYS)
description:
This dataset tracks construction and infrastructure projects that affect New York City parks, recording how those projects move through planning, design, permitting, and construction. Each row represents a project, with identifiers, a description of the work, the sponsoring agency, the impacted park or parks, borough, address or intersection, and whether the project spans multiple sites. It also captures contract values, current phase, and key milestone dates such as project receipt, scoping kickoff and response, design completion, construction kickoff, expected and actual construction end, substantial completion, and final inspection.

A large portion of the data concerns permits: construction permit requests, permit IDs, issuance, start, expiration, extensions and amendments, special conditions, forestry permit status and IDs, exploratory permits, and inspection and punchlist activity. Additional fields cover public design commission approvals, mass mailings, construction managers and contractors, borough approvals, final acceptance of the park, and geographic coordinates.

The data could be used to monitor project timelines and delays
